evidence: Carries the Wallet label and modifies wallet fast rescan logic to parallelize compact block filter checking with a new `-walletpar` option.
rationale: Parallelizes compact block filter evaluation during fast rescan to address long single-threaded wait times, achieving a 4.5x to nearly 8x speedup across multiple reviewers' benchmarks. Slow rescans are explicitly recognized under what matters for wallet reliability, making this a major user-facing performance gain without rising to the category-critical fund safety or correctness threshold of P1.
